global_contact_rules.current_contact: A record has current contact only when a verified current capability, source file, route, function, storage key, dependency, trust zone, or active project record directly touches the risk.
global_contact_rules.planned_contact: A record has planned contact only when an approved roadmap packet or named implementation/proof owner creates a specific future contact path.
global_contact_rules.absent_contact: A record has absent contact when neither current capability evidence nor an approved planned contact path reaches the risk.
global_contact_rules.scope_exclusion: A record is a scope exclusion only when a governing project boundary explicitly excludes that capability or domain.

global_boundary_evidence.statement: The current Resident uses local deterministic rules, stored context, and manual ChatGPT handoff; no verified direct AI-model call exists.
The optional worker/backend is not a completed current Resident capability.
AI/provider architecture and backend implementation are assigned to Packets 06, 06.5, 21, and 24, but remain prohibited until those packets pass.
Packet 03.7 is next and Packet 04 remains blocked until Packet 03.7 passes.
